title: Balanced hot local ports have a sharp collective-cooling work bound over non-Gaussian states

scientific_scope_status: For k equal-frequency canonical bosonic modes with H=hbar omega sum a_i^dagger a_i, initially tau_n tensor k at a sole preparation reservoir T>0, all Hamiltonians return to H. An arbitrary final state rho (not assumed Gaussian) has N_ij=Tr(rho a_j^dagger a_i), N_ii=n. A balanced rank-r orthogonal projector P has P_ii=r/k, 1<=r<k, and PNP<=nu P for 0<=nu<n. Put b=(kn-r nu)/(k-r) and g(x)=(x+1)ln(x+1)-x ln x. The source internally proves S(rho)<=r g(nu)+(k-r)g(b) and the exact minimum free-energy increase W_bal=k_B T[k g(n)-r g(nu)-(k-r)g(b)]. The bound is attained by a gauge-invariant Gaussian state N_star=nu P+b(I-P), with hot thermal local marginals. Historical novelty of this specialization of established principles is UNKNOWN.
